description: Create cute Cobie figurine animations and a user-ingestion pipeline that turns real people into personalized NPC figurines with social-sourced traits.

phases.name: Figurine Asset Pipeline
phases.description: Define Cobie visual system, asset export formats, and loader integration.

tasks.title: Cobie Visual Style System
tasks.description: Define the Cobie figurine style constraints and asset scale rules for in-game use.
acceptance_criteria: Style tokens: palette, material, proportions, silhouette rules
Naming convention for animations and variants

tasks.title: Figurine Asset Manifest
tasks.description: Add a manifest defining Cobie animation loops and variants for runtime loading.
acceptance_criteria: List of animation loops with id, fps, frames, duration
Variants for props (cap, phone, laptop, coffee, TV screen)

tasks.title: Runtime Loader Integration
tasks.description: Integrate figurine asset loading into the existing rendering flow.

phases.name: Cobie Animations + Event Triggers
phases.description: Create Cobie loop catalog and trigger them from game events.

tasks.title: Cobie Loop Catalog
tasks.description: Define the initial set of Cobie animation loops and their semantic meanings.
acceptance_criteria: At least 10 loops (idle, wave, hype, think, type, sleep, snack, react, cheer, shrug)
Each loop mapped to a gameplay trigger type

tasks.title: Cobie Event Hook
tasks.description: Hook Cobie animations to existing game events and UI notifications.

tasks.title: Cobie TV Screen Prop
tasks.description: Add a small diegetic TV screen object that plays Cobie loops in-world.

phases.name: User Ingestion Backend
phases.description: Identity, consent, and data ingestion for user-to-NPC conversion.

tasks.title: Consent + Identity Flow
tasks.description: Add explicit consent gating and identity binding for user ingestion.
acceptance_criteria: Audit log entry for consent action

tasks.title: Social Data Intake Adapter
tasks.description: Create a pluggable adapter interface for social metadata ingestion.

tasks.title: Avatar Render Queue
tasks.description: Queue avatar generation requests for user figurines.

phases.name: Personality Synthesis
phases.description: Map social metadata to NPC trait vectors and dialogue seeds.

tasks.title: Trait Mapping Engine
tasks.description: Convert social metadata to Big Five + crypto traits.

tasks.title: Dialogue Seed Generator
tasks.description: Generate dialogue seed tokens from traits and interests.
acceptance_criteria: Seed tokens stored on NPC profile

phases.name: NPC Integration + Housing
phases.description: Spawn ingested users as NPCs and enable housing selection.

tasks.title: Spawn Ingested NPC
tasks.description: Create NPC instances from ingested profiles.
acceptance_criteria: NPCs spawn with avatar + trait vector

tasks.title: Housing Selection Behavior
tasks.description: Add behavior for ingested NPCs to find and select housing.
acceptance_criteria: Selects housing based on affordability and vibe
Does not mutate grid state from renderer

tasks.title: Safety Filters
tasks.description: Apply content filtering for generated dialogue and traits.

tasks.title: Ingestion Test Suite
tasks.description: Add tests for trait mapping, spawn logic, and housing selection.
